annotation.title_clean: Может ли интеллектуальный робот обладать этическими свойствами?
annotation.title_en: Can an Intelligent Robot Be Able to Have Ethical Features?
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Дубровский, Д.И.; Ефимов, А.Р.; Матвеев, Ф.М.
annotation.summary_en: Philosophical journal article abstract on whether intelligent robots and artificial general-intelligence agents can have ethical properties. Proposes building partial models based on an activity classifier to algorithmize ethical functions, noting continuity of algorithmic ethical models and reinforcement learning to model uncertainty and pain-like mechanisms.
key_provisions_or_claims: Ethics cannot give engineers a hierarchical normative architecture for computational implementation.
Partial models based on an activity classifier can algorithmize ethical functions.
Algorithmic models of ethical systems are continual.
Reinforcement learning is effective for modeling uncertainty and pain as a factor in moral behavior.
